doc.title: Bobby Johnson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998

title: Opening and Pensacola upbringing
summary: Monk Rowe introduces Bobby Johnson Jr. for the Hamilton archive; he grew up in Pensacola.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: We are filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive in the Catskills. And I am extremely pleased to have trumpeter and veteran musician Bobby Johnson Jr. with me. Thank you so much for coming.
You have just been telling me some fascinating things, and we’ll have to tell them again. But you grew up in Pensacola, Florida?
